en.topic_title: China expels ex-Xinjiang official from Communist Party over graft
en.topic_summary:
China expelled a former top Xinjiang official from the ruling Communist Party and removed him from all his posts over corruption allegations, including nepotism, bribery, and paying for sex, state media said Tuesday.



Ma Xingrui, Xinjiang Communist Party Secretary, attends the Xinjiang delegation meeting during the National People’s Congress (NPC) at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on March 7, 2025. Photo:Adek Berry/AFP.



Ma Xingrui, 66, was a member of the Communist Party&#821
